items.title: AVGO Q2 Deep Dive: AI Semiconductor Surge Faces Supply Headwinds and Guidance Caution
items.summary: Fabless chip and software maker Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 85.5% year on year to $29.59 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $34.8 billion was less impressive, coming in 1.1% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.32 per share was 2.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
